# GenerateFromId

Generates and publishes content referenced by an identifier in a folder

```text
String outputFiles = GenerateFromId ( String id, String publishingDir )
```

## Parameters

**id** Content identifier

**publishingDir** Publication folder

## Return value(s)

**outputFiles** List of generated files

## Features

**Schema:** [ncm:publishing](s-ncm-publishing.md)

**Static:**

Yes
